options.content: ● fine   ● needs attention   ● data problem   ● not applicable  ·  ⓘ limits and definitions  ·  For engineering and Ensaras support

panels.description: Fresh = readings in the last 5 minutes; Late = last reading 5–15 minutes ago; Stale = nothing for 15 minutes.

targets.query: SELECT count(*) FROM "${measurement}" WHERE time > now() - 15m

panels.title: Data feed

panels.description: Time of the most recent reading stored in InfluxDB.

targets.query: SELECT * FROM "${measurement}" WHERE time > now() - 30d ORDER BY time DESC LIMIT 1

panels.title: Last reading

panels.description: Readings stored in the last 24 hours ÷ 1,440 (one per minute). Healthy ≥ 98 %, attention 90–98 %, problem below 90 %. Sites that send more than one reading a minute show 100 %+; use the hourly chart on the site view to spot their gaps.

targets.query: SELECT count(*) FROM "${measurement}" WHERE time > now() - 24h GROUP BY time(1h) fill(0)

panels.title: Completeness, last 24 h

panels.description: A daily form is one entered on at least 20 of the last 30 days (from its own history). Missed = no entry dated yesterday (IST).

panels.title: Daily forms missed yesterday

panels.description: Most readings received for any tag in each hour. 60 = one per minute; lower bars show gaps.

targets.query: SELECT count(*) FROM "${measurement}" WHERE $timeFilter GROUP BY time(1h) fill(0)

panels.title: Readings stored per hour · expected 60

panels.description: Tags seen in the last 7 days with no reading in the last 60 minutes. A renamed tag also appears here for up to 7 days.

targets.query: SELECT count(*) FROM "${measurement}" WHERE time > now() - 60m
SELECT count(*) FROM "${measurement}" WHERE time > now() - 7d

panels.title: Stopped arriving · no reading for 60 min

panels.description: Counters and totalizers (found by name: total, totalizer, runtime, running hours) whose hourly minimum dropped below the previous hour. Catches resets and zero glitches. The largest drop is shown.

targets.query: SELECT min(*) FROM (SELECT difference(min(/(?i)(total|totlyzer|FIQ|runtime|running_hours_hr)/)) FROM "${measurement}" WHERE time > now() - 7d GROUP BY time(1h) fill(none)) WHERE time > now() - 7d
